snippet.title: After Lights Out | Horror Game Awards HALLOWEEN SHOWCASE WORLD PREMIERE TRAILER 2025
snippet.description:
After Lights Out is a first-person psychological horror game developed by POQI STUDIO. What if you wake in the darkness with no memory, forced to delve into the shadows to uncover the truth behind a sinister disappearance—will you dare to seek answers between the fading light and creeping dread?

Your only tools are the fleeting sources of light you manage to find. Use photography to develop hidden clues, solve environmental puzzles that merge with the narrative, and navigate the fragile boundary between illumination and terror—some truths emerge only after the lights go out.

After Lights Out is coming to PC in 2026, and is now available to wishlist on Steam.

STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3611700/After_Lights_Out/

#thehorrorgameawards #HorrorGamesShowcase
---
The Horror Game Awards started towards the end of 2022 as a Horror Game of the Year Award set up by two die hard horror game fans. Fourteen content creators made up that year’s jury. It was such a success that in 2023 the jury doubled in size and the awards expanded their scope.

The aim of the awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
